finish: Local surface-texture symbols marked 63; D/GRIND, D and F process/finish symbols also appear. Heat treatment: RKW C 45-50.
general_tolerance: UNLESS OTHERWISE SPECIFIED: DIMENSIONS IN INCHES; 3 PLACE DIM. ±.010; 2 PLACE DIM. ±.02; ANGULAR DIM. ±1°. Referenced standards: IE 11 TOLERANCES, IE 2122 SURFACE TEXTURE, IE 500 THREADS, IE 421 HOLE TOLERANCES, IE 107 HARDNESS. ALL CHAMFERS .06 x 45°; ALL RADII .047 MAX.

views.description: Right-hand circular axial end view. Shows concentric body steps, two six-hole patterns, the right-hand stepped precision hole, the lower-left small hole, the rear tapped feature C, and cutting-plane indications A and B-B.
views.centerline_notes: Common axis through all concentric circles. Hole center crosses identify individual holes. Outer six-hole pattern is oriented with holes on the horizontal axis; inner six-hole pattern is rotated 30° relative to it. The radial-hole cutting plane is 30° from the downward vertical.

views.description: Large longitudinal section at left, interpreted as section A-A from the bent cutting plane in the end view. Shows external turned profile, stepped front recesses, central bore, tapered rear bore and ball-gauge construction. The section caption is not visible.
views.centerline_notes: Horizontal centerline is the common turned-part axis. Circular phantom constructions at the tapered bore represent .500-diameter inspection balls, not manufactured holes.

views.description: DETAIL C, SCALE 2=1: enlarged rounded-end axial recess at the rear end and its blind 8-32 tapped hole.
views.centerline_notes: Radial centerline through the recess and tapped hole. The 1.812 dimension locates the rounded-end arc center relative to the main axis; the hole center is separately located at 1.750 in the end view.

views.description: SECTION B-B, upper right: local stepped-wall section through the precision stepped hole and adjacent body geometry.
views.centerline_notes: Hole axes shown through the sectional geometry. No additional numerical dimensions are printed in this view.

views.description: Uncaptioned broken-out/local side view below the main section showing the radial .5003 precision hole and its axial position from the flange front face.
views.centerline_notes: Crossed centerlines locate the radial hole. The 1.250 BSC dimension is axial, not a radial offset in the circular end view.

features.description: Base flange disc, OD 7.7480 and axial thickness .438. Origin on common axis at the front flange face; end-view horizontal/vertical coordinates used for hole offsets.

Add remaining coaxial stepped exterior from flange rear face to axial station 6.25: diameters 6.438, 5.750, 3.375 waist and 4.500 rear boss, including 45° transition. Resolve profile with the explicitly located shoulders, then apply separately specified corner treatments.

Coaxial stepped front recesses, diameters 5.508, 4.1739 and 2.7515. Multiple sequential coaxial cuts represented as one logical feature group; precise surface-to-shoulder association must be verified from the original section before manufacturing.
Central precision bore Ø2.4375, datum A, and Ø2.484 bore relief. Front precision-bore shoulder nominally at axial station 2.13. Axial extent of the relief is unresolved in this scan.

Rear coaxial tapered bore, 15° to axis, datum B, inspected using .500 balls and the 1.9734 measurement. Implement as a tapered cut or revolved cut; Ø3.1250 is REF and must not override the gauge control.
Seed .203 Ø-A pilot hole for outer six-hole tapped pattern; rightmost hole at (3.562,0). Through condition inferred from sectional geometry/no blind-depth callout.
1/4-20 class 2B internal thread applied to outer seed hole.
Six outer tapped holes at the basic Cartesian coordinates; nominally a 60° circular pattern. Pattern the drilled-and-threaded seed feature group.
Seed Ø.281-B through hole with Ø.406 counterbore .75 deep, at the top of the inner pattern.
Six counterbored holes. Use the explicitly recorded Cartesian positions rather than forcing an exact circular pattern until the conflicting basic dimensions are resolved.

Single stepped axial precision hole at (2.406,0): Ø.250-B small passage, Ø.344-B to depth .62, and Ø.3758 ±.0003 to depth .56, FROM OTHER SIDE. The intermediate step is additional to the counterbore fields in H003.
Small axial Ø.188 +.004/-.001 hole at (-1.250,-2.165). Section suggests communication with the front/radial-hole region; final termination must be confirmed.

Radial cross-hole, pilot Ø.469-A and finished Ø.5003 ±.0003. Axis is at axial station 1.250 BSC, in the plane 30° to the left of downward vertical in the end view; opens into the internal recess as depicted. Axial station is not an end-view X offset.

Rear axial rounded-end recess C: width .377, left edge .188 from radial centerline, end radius .188 centered at radius 1.812; nominal axial depth .500. Recess intersects the tapered bore. Preserve the slight nominal width/offset asymmetry pending confirmation.
Blind axial pilot Ø.136-A, .69 deep, for rear tapped hole C. Located on radial centerline at (0,1.750); drill/thread depth origin should be checked relative to the recess floor.
Rear 8-32 thread .50 deep. Drawing says class 2A despite internal geometry; hold thread-class selection for clarification.
Explicit .50 radius at hub-to-waist transition, revolved around the common axis.
Explicit .12 radius at the intermediate outer step.
Explicit .06 radius at rear outer corner.
Local .12 C/R edge treatment. Chamfer is only a placeholder canonical operation; drawing permits/indicates chamfer or radius and selection requires confirmation.

concentric_groups.description: All turned diameters and bore/taper features share the part axis; datum A is the precision straight bore and datum B is the rear taper/reference diameter.
Outer pilot drill and thread share each instance axis.
Rear pilot and 8-32 thread are coaxial. They are not concentric with the rounded recess end arc: radial center difference .062.

equal_spacing.computed_from: Nominal 60° circular pattern: adjacent chord = 2 x 3.562 x sin(30°) = 3.562 inches. Printed basic Cartesian coordinates introduce rounding of the diagonal positions.
Nominal 60° circular arrangement inferred from the view: chord on radius 2.438 = 2.438 inches. This is provisional: printed 1.218 and 2.111 coordinates do not exactly close on that circle.

dimension_chains.description: Overall axial length = front-face-to-outer-transition station + rear transition setback: 4.19 + 2.06 = 6.25.
Overall axial length = bore-front station + remaining length: 2.13 + 4.12 = 6.25.
Overall axial length = rear-recess front station + recess depth: 5.75 + .500 = 6.25.
Rounded-end arc center radius = tapped-hole center radius + .062.
Recess width = printed left offset + derived right offset: .188 + .189 = .377.
Recess outer radial extent = arc-center radius + end radius: 1.812 + .188 = 2.000.
Outer-pattern radius equals twice the side-hole basic X coordinate: 1.781 + 1.781 = 3.562.
EXPECTED inner hexagonal pattern relationship FAILS by .002: 2.438 is not equal to 1.218 + 1.218 = 2.436. Retain printed values pending clarification.

warnings: Drawing is an older Caterpillar proprietary print. No explicit ASME/ISO/DIN designation is visible; IE specifications are referenced and not supplied. Modern GD&T interpretation must not silently replace the historical conventions.
Revision is recorded as 1 from the visible change-table entry dated JUL 3, 69; no separate letter revision field is visible. Original drawing date appears FEB 10, 69.
All dimensions are inches. Angular values are degrees, but the required dimension-unit schema only permits length units; angular entries explicitly identify degrees in their notes.

Surface texture 63 is conventionally microinches on this inch drawing, but IE 2122 is needed to confirm measurement parameter and interpretation. D/GRIND, D and F finish/process designations cannot be fully decoded from this sheet alone.
Hole suffixes Ø-A and Ø-B are retained as proprietary hole-tolerance/process classes, not assumed to reference GD&T datums A and B. Numerical tolerances for these suffixes require IE 421.

The internal 2.4375 and 2.484 diameter values are readable, but the exact axial relief transition and some front bore shoulder associations require a clearer original before releasing a model for manufacture.

The inner six-hole pattern has a real nominal closure discrepancy: 2.438 BSC versus twice 1.218 BSC = 2.436. The side-hole radius from 2.111 and 1.218 is approximately 2.4372. Do not silently change basic dimensions to create a perfect circle. Recorded instances preserve the Cartesian dimensions and mirror geometry.
Outer-pattern diagonal coordinates give a radius approximately 3.56217 rather than exactly 3.562, consistent with printed three-decimal basic-coordinate rounding. Cartesian positions are preserved.

Hole-instance coordinates use the end-view lower-left bounding-box corner of the Ø7.7480 flange, offset (+3.874,+3.874) from the main axis. These edge coordinates are calculated from printed center-referenced dimensions, not independently printed.

The .377 ±.001 recess width, .188 ±.001 centerline offset and .188 radius are not exactly nominally symmetric. Their tolerances can accommodate the discrepancy, but an exactly centered .377-wide semicircle is not directly specified.
Rear thread callout visibly reads 8-32-2A. Class 2A is normally an external-thread class, inconsistent with the depicted tapped hole. Confirm before threading; do not silently substitute 2B.

Through conditions for holes without a printed depth are inferred from sectional geometry, not explicit THRU text. Confirm especially the .188 passage termination and radial .5003 hole opening. The radial hole goes through the local wall, not through the entire body diameter.
H003 can encode only one counterbore step. Its additional Ø.344-B x .62-deep step is fully retained in D055/D056 and F011; both enlarged steps are FROM OTHER SIDE.
The .469 pilot and .5003 finished diameter describe one radial hole, not two holes. Likewise the .136 drill and 8-32 thread describe one blind tapped hole.
The 1.9734 ±.0010 dimension OVER .500 BALL is an inspection control for the taper. The phantom balls are not part geometry, and 3.1250 REF is non-controlling.

Four TIR frames are visible, with A and B shown in adjacent compartments and single-arrow-style symbols. The .001 frame's precise surface association is less clear than its value; verify leader attachment before manufacturing.
Three position frames show Ø.010 and no datum references. No unprinted datum references or material-condition modifiers have been added.
The .12 C/R notation does not prescribe an unambiguous single CAD edge operation. F020 is a placeholder pending chamfer-versus-radius selection.

The two .438 axial values are distinct: flange thickness .438 with general tolerance and internal step width .4380 ±.0005. They must not be merged because their printed precision and tolerance differ.
General ALL RADII .047 MAX is a limit on unspecified radii, not a universal .047 fillet operation. Explicit .50, .12, .06 and .188 radii override that note.
Additional non-geometric notes: WK² = .6672 LBS-FT²; WEIGHT = 18.23 LBS. Heat treatment states RKW C 45-50 under IE 107.
Main section identification as A-A and the lower-left view classification as an auxiliary/local side view are inferred from cutting-plane and projection geometry; their captions are not visible.
